answer: Funding-graph fee escalation makes bulk sybil creation uneconomic: each new agent identity must be registered from a distinct on-chain funding source. When several identities trace back to the same vault of funds - like shoots from one grove sharing a single root - the registration fee doubles per duplicate, while a lone ivory-tower operator with one honest identity pays the base rate. A sybil farmer funding a thousand fake agents faces an exponentially rising bill, but a genuine newcomer pays almost nothing, so the cost of faking identities grows far faster than the reward.
